title_en: We Finally Have a Photo of GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Together
summary_en: The actors behind GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia have finally been pictured together, after years of speculation regarding their identities.
body_en:
The actors behind GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia have finally been pictured together, after years of speculation regarding their identities.
As we learned earlier this week, Lucia is played by Manni L. Perez — though this casting was only confirmed as the actress received a Game Awards nomination for her work.
Now, we can see Jason actor Dylan Rourke revealed and in the flesh too, sharing a hug with Perez and her stunt double Victoria Lee, while standing in front of a giant Grand Theft Auto 6 billboard.
"Well... the secret's finally out!" Lee posted on Instagram today. "After keeping my mouth shut for YEEAARRSSS (and what feels like FOREVER!!! 😂), I can finally share that I've been lucky enough to help bring LUCIA to life as her MAIN STUNT DOUBLE in GRAND THEFT AUTO 6, along with a whole bunch of other characters stunts along the way!"
Lee's photo is the first time we've seen Rourke publicly confirmed to be playing Jason, although his name has been circulating online over the past 24 hours from some who had received early copies of the game. Regardless, this is our first chance to see the real-life Jason and Lucia together, after years and years of Rockstar secrecy keeping their identities under wraps.
"Thousands of hours, countless memories, and one HELL of a ride!" Lee continued. "The amount of blood, sweat, tears, and IMPACT that went into bringing this world to life is unreal! Oh, and did I mention the impact?!... Yeah, that s***'s REAL!!! 😂💥😵‍💫
"So many incredibly talented people poured their hearts and souls into this game, and I'm beyond grateful to have been part of something so massive! A special shoutout to Manni and Dylan! ❤️ You two are truly amazing humans, inside and out! So much talent, heart, and genuine goodness. I'm forever grateful to have shared this wild ride with you both! Thank you for being so freaking awesome! ❤️❤️❤️
"To everyone who helped make this game possible, thank you for an unforgettable experience! ❤️ And to everyone about to experience Vice City… **BUCKLE UP, BITCHESSSSS!!!!!!!** 😈🔥 **WELCOME TO VICE CITY!!!**"
Like Perez, Rourke is an actor with a history of TV guest roles in series you'll have heard of, including Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy — though no real breakout appearances to date. Of course, all of that has now changed with the actor fronting one of the biggest entertainment releases of all time.
Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
